_comment: Project fidelity config for the AppHeader brand + KYC banner master. Inherits tolerances from the home config (figma-home-redesign/fidelity.home.config.json) but tightens scope to AppHeader-only nodes. Wordmark vector subnodes (8 paths under I619:8197;514:5532) are waived as icon-deviations — the impl ships the PNG wordmark.
_toleranceNote: x/y/w/h/padding tolerance 2 (matches toast/dialog/segmented masters): the CJK glyph ink box for '中' renders 15-px tall in the OS fallback font vs figma's HarmonyOS Sans TC 14-px, shifting anchor-aligned coords by ~1-1.5 px on every other node. Sub-pixel jitter is acknowledged in the skill SKILL.md ('DO NOT chase sub-pixel minor noise').
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; impl ships PlusJakartaSans + system CJK fallback. Same family alias contract used across cards/auth/buttons.
